# Al Mowahid Recruitment

> Campaign landing site for Al Mowahid Recruitment in Al Khobar and the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia.

## Main pages
- [Campaign home](https://almowahid.sa/ads/)
- [Recruitment office](https://almowahid.sa/ads/recruitment-office/)
- [Domestic workers](https://almowahid.sa/ads/domestic-workers/)
- [Philippines domestic workers](https://almowahid.sa/ads/philippines/)
- [Ethiopia domestic workers](https://almowahid.sa/ads/ethiopia/)
- [Other recruitment nationalities](https://almowahid.sa/ads/nationalities/)
- [Private driver from India](https://almowahid.sa/ads/drivers/)
- [Offers, availability and installments](https://almowahid.sa/ads/offers-fast/)
- [About Al Mowahid](https://almowahid.sa/ads/about/)
- [Frequently asked questions](https://almowahid.sa/ads/faq/)
- [Privacy policy](https://almowahid.sa/ads/privacy/)

## Service rules
- Domestic workers are offered from Sri Lanka, the Philippines, Bangladesh, Kenya, Ethiopia, Burundi and Uganda.
- India is used for the private-driver service only.
- Fixed recruitment prices are not published on the campaign site.
- Installment options may be available subject to provider eligibility and current terms.
